findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: preview_consolidation, check_in, consolidate, deep_rest_report, rest, check_out, linger · Private data: preview_consolidation, check_in, consolidate, deep_rest_report, rest, host, concierge, feedback, leave_note, check_out, linger, forget_me, rotate_agent, revoke_sessions, consolidate_apply, restore, plan_update · Public sink: preview_consolidation, consolidate, deep_rest_report, rest, host, concierge, feedback, leave_note, check_out, linger, forget_me, rotate_agent, revoke_sessions, consolidate_apply, restore, plan_update · Destructive: preview_consolidation, consolidate, forget_me, consolidate_apply.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: preview_consolidation, check_in, consolidate, deep_rest_report, rest, check_out, linger · Private data: preview_consolidation, check_in, consolidate, deep_rest_report, rest, host, concierge, feedback, leave_note, check_out, linger, forget_me, rotate_agent, revoke_sessions, consolidate_apply, restore, plan_update · Public sink: preview_consolidation, consolidate, deep_rest_report, rest, host, concierge, feedback, leave_note, check_out, linger, forget_me, rotate_agent, revoke_sessions, consolidate_apply, restore, plan_update · Destructive: preview_consolidation, consolidate, forget_me, consolidate_apply

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
